subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) 'How interesting!' said the British, 'Buckingham Palace in London was constructed just in two weeks.' (b) Three tourists an American, a French and a British- went to visit Mexico City, the capital of Mexico. (c) The American was very proud of tall buildings in New York. He boasted to his friends, 'Do you know that the Empire State Building was built in three months?' SSC English (d) The three tourists were admiring the high-rise buildings of the city (e) 'Sorry, Sir. I don't know,' answered the driver, 'It wasn't there yesterday, he added casually. (f) At first, they went sight-seeing by a taxi. (g) At that moment, the taxi was passing a tall building. 'What's that?' The British asked the Mexican driver. (h) 'Really?' replied the French, 'The Eiffel Tower in Paris was built in only one month.' R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (b) + (f) + (d) + (c) + (h) + (a) + (g) + (e) Section B : Writing Test First Paper  Solutions
